findings.summary: New fill_buf() call drops the Interrupted retry that read_until gave the first read, so a first read returning EINTR now makes Input::open fail (confirmed by check)
Fallback comment names the wrong trigger (stdin is the common case) and the body omits that piped input only inspects its first read
CONTENT_INSPECTION_LIMIT and the .min() slices duplicate a limit content_inspector already enforces; drop them and the 1024-byte test
read_line_unbuffered has the same missing Interrupted retry (pre-existing, untouched by the PR)

why: One blocking finding: the EINTR regression on the first read, which the check confirmed against the code. The maintainers merged without changes, so it counts against the reviewer. The other three are nits or pre-existing.
